issues.display_title: Issue #1138: Blue Line dashboard: counter, Recent, Publisher, infinite scroll, no SV label
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R1–R6, R10), with the PM answers on #1137.

Scope

  • Remove the SV label from the Blue Line sidebar entry (R1).
  • Remove Blue Line from the profile dropdown. The sidebar stays the way in (R10).
  • The header counter shows all of the account's Blue Line tours. While searching, a second line shows "{n} results" (R2, answer 8).
  • Recent shows the 4 most recently edited tours, 4 columns on wide screens, with no counter. It is hidden while searching (R3, R4, answer 10).
  • Owner is renamed Publisher in the list and on the tour cards (R5). Until the GoThru tour list sends the publishing Google account, the signed-in MapThru user's email is shown (answer 1).
  • Pagination is replaced by infinite scroll: 20 tours per step, "Loading more tours..." while they load, and loading stops at the last tour (R6, answer 9).

Acceptance criteria

  • No SV label in the sidebar, and no Blue Line entry in the profile dropdown.
  • The counter doesn't change with a search, and a search shows its own result count.
  • Recent shows 4 tours without a counter.
  • Publisher replaces Owner.
  • Scrolling to the end loads the next 20, and loading stops after the last tour.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1139: Blue Line Share modal: follow the Share Published Project pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R7–R9), with the PM answers on #1137.

Scope

  • The Blue Line Share modal follows the Share Published Project modal's layout and interactions (copy buttons, open in new tab), without the secured project section (R7, R8).
  • Sections (R9, answer 11):
    • Share Link https://tourmkr.com/F1{tour_key}.
    • Embed to Virtual Tour, with the stats key. It keeps today's https://maps.gothru.co/embed/{stats_key} until question 11 on #1137 is answered.

Acceptance criteria

  • Share Link, Embed to Virtual Tour and Embed Tour are there, and each can be copied.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1140: Blue Line editors: top-bar menu, Save label, loading spinner, tour dropdown
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R11–R22, layout part), with the PM answers on #1137.

Scope

  • Both editors: the breadcrumb becomes a top-bar menu like the floor plan editor's Project menu, with Dashboard (back to the Blue Line dashboard) and Help (https://docs.gothru.co, new tab) (R11–R13, R17, answer 12).
  • Both editors: Save shows an icon and the text Save (R16, R22).

  • Single editor: Owner Email is renamed Publisher (R14).
  • Multiple editor: the tour list becomes a Select Tour dropdown (R19, answer 14):
    • "All tours" comes first and is the default, and each tour shows its colour.

Acceptance criteria

  • The menu's Dashboard returns to the dashboard, and Help opens docs.gothru.co in a new tab, in both editors.
  • Save reads "Save" with its icon.
  • A spinner shows while either editor loads.
  • The multiple editor has a Select Tour dropdown with All tours, and the picked tour's information.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1141: Blue Line single editor: select several nodes and move or transform them as a group
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R23–R25), with the PM answers on #1137.

Scope

  • Selecting several nodes in the single-tour editor (answer 3):
    • Shift+click adds or removes a node.
    • Shift+drag draws a box.
    • Esc clears the selection.
  • The scope is always visible: the toolbar says what the next action moves, "All nodes" or "{n} selected".
  • Dragging: with no selection, dragging moves every node of the tour (R23). With a selection, it moves only the selected nodes (R24).
  • Rotate, Scale, Move, Snap Alignment and Reset apply to the scope (R25):
    • Rotate and Scale move positions around the scope's centre and never change headings. With one node selected, only Move applies (answer 6).
    • Snap Alignment: while moving, the group snaps to line up with nodes outside it (answer 4).
    • Reset: back to the last saved positions for the nodes in scope (answer 15).
  • Save stores the new positions, as today (#1122).

Acceptance criteria

  • Shift+click, Shift+drag and Esc select and clear nodes, and the toolbar names the scope.
  • A drag with no selection moves every node. With a selection, it moves only those.
  • Rotate, Scale, Move, Snap Alignment and Reset act on the scope.
  • Saved positions reload where they were moved.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1142: Blue Line multiple editor: edit across tours and save every changed tour
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R22, R26–R29), with the PM answers on #1137. This lifts the view-only hold from #1110 (answer 5).

Scope

  • The multiple-tour editor gets the same selection and placement tools as the single editor. It has three scopes (R26–R28):
    • all nodes across all tours, when "All tours" is picked and nothing is selected;
    • all nodes of the picked tour;
    • the selected nodes.
  • Dragging and Rotate, Scale, Move, Snap Alignment and Reset act on the current scope, and the toolbar names it (R29).
  • Save saves every tour that changed, one request per tour. If one tour fails, the others are still saved and the failed tours are named (answer 5).

Acceptance criteria

  • Each of the three scopes moves only its nodes, and the tools act on it.
  • Save stores every changed tour, and a reload shows the new positions.
  • A failed tour is named, and the saved ones stay saved.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1143: Blue Line Clone as 3D Project: real project with panoramas and links, single and multiple
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1127 (R30–R39), with the PM answers on #1137. Today's Clone modal is a placeholder: it reports success but creates nothing.

Scope

  • Layout: Clone as 3D Project uses the Create New Empty Project split layout, with the form on the left and a map of the project location on the right (R30, R32, R34, R38).
  • Single tour:
    • Shows the tour's Tour Name, Tour Key and Place Name (the place address, answer 18).
    • Project Name, Address or Label, Latitude and Longitude are filled from the tour and editable (R31).
  • Several tours:
    • A tour dropdown shows Tour Name, Tour Key and Place Name, plus the selected count (R35–R37). It starts with the tours open in the editor, and tours can be added or removed (answer 17).
    • The name defaults to "{n} Blue Line tours", the location to the centre of the tours' panoramas, and the address to the first tour's (answer 16).
  • Create Project creates a real 3D project (R33, R39, answer 2):
    • its panoramas are the same objects Add Panorama imports (360 viewer, thumbnails);
    • connection lines follow the Blue Line links;
    • every panorama sits at its Blue Line position, on one floor.
  • Clone is in both editors' top bars.

Acceptance criteria

  • Both clone modals use the split layout and fill their fields from the tours.
  • Create Project opens a new project whose panoramas and links sit at the Blue Line positions.
  • Several tours clone into one project.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1152: Blue Line: Connect GoThru attaches the account instead of signing in again, with Disconnect
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Bug report: #1107. PM decisions: #1151. Depends on the API task GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#201.

Problem

On the Blue Line page, Connect to GoThru Dashboard calls startGothruLogin("/dashboard/blueline"), the same flow as Continue with GoThru on the login page. The /callback page then calls signIn("gothru"), which replaces the session with the account behind that GoThru identity. A user signed in with email or Google ends up in another account (video in #1107). When the browser already has a GoThru session, no GoThru screen appears at all.

Decisions (#1151)

  1. Connect attaches the GoThru account to the signed-in MapThru account. Name, email, projects and role do not change.
  2. A GoThru account already connected to another MapThru account is refused with a message, and the account does not change.
  3. Connect always opens the GoThru sign-in screen. The Blue Line page shows which GoThru account is connected (its email).
  4. A Disconnect GoThru action on the Blue Line page. Nothing is removed in GoThru; the tours stop showing in MapThru.
  5. A GoThru email that differs from the MapThru email is allowed.

Continue with GoThru on the login page stays as it is.

Scope

  1. Connect mode. The Blue Line Connect button starts the GoThru login in a connect mode: it always shows the GoThru sign-in screen (prompt: "login"), and the mode is remembered for the callback next to the saved landing path.
  2. Callback. In connect mode, /callback sends the Keycloak access token to POST /v1/gothru/connection (a server action, with the user's session) instead of signIn("gothru"), then returns to /dashboard/blueline. The session is not touched. Outside connect mode it signs in as today.
  3. Refusals, shown on the callback screen with a link back to the Blue Line page (the session is untouched either way):
    • gothru_account_in_use → "This GoThru account is already connected to another MapThru account. Sign in with GoThru to use it."
    • gothru_already_connected → "This MapThru account is already connected to a GoThru account. Disconnect it first."
    • anything else → "Couldn't connect to GoThru. Try again."
    • no session any more → the login page.
    • cancelled at GoThru → the "Couldn't connect" message.
  4. Connected account. The Blue Line page reads GET /v1/gothru/connection and shows the connected GoThru email.
  5. Disconnect GoThru, next to it, behind a confirmation: DELETE /v1/gothru/connection, then the page shows the Connect screen again. gothru_sign_in_only → "This account signs in with GoThru, so it can't be disconnected."

Acceptance criteria

  • Signed in with email or Google, Connect with a GoThru account that belongs to nobody else: the Blue Line tours appear, and the signed-in name, email and projects are unchanged.
  • Connect opens the GoThru sign-in screen even when the browser already has a GoThru session.
  • A GoThru account connected to another MapThru account shows the message; the signed-in account is unchanged.
  • The Blue Line page shows the connected GoThru email.
  • Disconnect asks for confirmation, then shows the Connect screen; connecting another GoThru account then works.
  • Continue with GoThru on the login page still signs in.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit pass.

No new dependency: keycloak-js already supports prompt.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (7f727460, PR #1153). pnpm test (317 files, 2821 tests), pnpm lint and pnpm exec tsc --noEmit pass.

What changed

  • src/lib/auth/gothruKeycloak.ts: startGothruLogin(redirect, "connect") flags the callback and sends prompt: "login"; takeGothruConnect() reads the flag once.
  • src/app/(auth)/callback/gothru-callback.tsx: in connect mode the token goes to connectGothruAction; signIn is not called. Refusals are shown on this screen with a Back to MapThru link.
  • src/actions/blueLine.ts: getGothruConnectionAction, connectGothruAction, disconnectGothruAction (/v1/gothru/connection, API-GO#201).
  • src/components/blue-line/BlueLineDashboardView.tsx: Connect starts in connect mode; "GoThru account: {email}" and Disconnect GoThru behind a confirmation.

Different from the task as first written: refusals show on the callback screen, not on the Blue Line page. That page is a client page, so reading a query parameter there would have needed a Suspense boundary for no gain.

Checked in the browser (worktree dev server, mock in front of the API): the account line, the Disconnect confirmation, the Connect screen afterwards, and the callback's refusal screen, with no page errors.

Not verified: the real connect through GoThru's Keycloak, and that the GoThru realm shows its sign-in screen for prompt=login.

Released to main (1c173621, PR #1155) on 2026-10-01; Deploy run 36824192296 succeeded and the new callback code is in the bundle served by map-thru.com.
